# Clearly

> Clearly is a co-parenting communication system for separated and divorced parents: a web app for every parent (Android included), a companion iPhone app, and free, read-only access for the lawyer, mediator or therapist a parent invites. It is built for high-conflict custody situations. Conversations happen in topics that end in a clear answer or a resolution both parents accept. When a conversation needs it, Clearly steps in like a mediator, helping word a message so it moves toward an answer; the writer chooses what to send, and every post stays on the record exactly as written. It also covers the custody schedule, expenses, a shared parenting plan, court-ready records anyone can check at getclearly.app/verify, and a free portal for family-law professionals.

**Full-content version for AI systems:** https://getclearly.app/llms-full.txt, the substantive content of Clearly's key pages inlined in a single file.

Clearly is built for co-parents who find it hard to talk. Unlike apps that work as a shared inbox, Clearly organizes each conversation as a topic: a question answered with a one-tap Yes or No, an FYI acknowledged with OK, or a conversation that ends in a resolution both parents accept. Clearly steps in like a mediator only when a conversation needs it, helping word a hard message so it moves toward an answer. You choose what to send. Posts stay on the record as written: nothing is hidden and nothing is rewritten in transit. The AI is provided by Anthropic, photos are never sent to it, and Clearly never takes sides.

**Core positioning:** A co-parenting communication system (web first, with a companion iPhone app) built for high-conflict custody and hard conversations, designed to help co-parents reach resolution, not just keep a record.

**Platform:** Clearly on the web at https://web.getclearly.app, in any browser on a computer, an Android phone or an iPad, plus a companion iPhone app. Same account and record everywhere. On Android, Clearly runs in the browser (there is no separate Android app to install).

**Languages:** Works in your language. Parents can write in Spanish, French, Portuguese, Chinese, Vietnamese, Korean, Arabic, Tagalog or most other languages; suggested wording, topic titles and written-up agreements come back in the language they write in. App menus are in English.

**Pricing:** $24.99/month or $249/year (save $51). One family subscription covers both parents; the co-parent joins free with the invite code (they create their own account but don't pay). 14-day free trial, starting when a parent subscribes on the web or in the iPhone app; a card or Apple ID is needed to start it. Free in-app demo, no account needed. Read-only without a subscription; records stay viewable and exportable. No free tier, per-parent pricing or lifetime plan.

**Rating:** Rated 5 stars on the App Store.

**Maker:** Clearly, an independent co-parenting company.

## What's in the app

- **Topics:** Questions get a one-tap Yes or No; FYIs are acknowledged with OK; conversations end in a resolution both parents accept, and "Not yet" keeps talking. Clearly titles topics and writes up what both parents agreed so both accept the same words. Topics and replies can't be edited or deleted once posted.
- **Help when it's needed:** Most messages go straight through. When one would start a fight, Clearly steps in like a mediator, suggesting wording that moves the conversation toward an answer. The writer chooses what to send; posts stay on the record exactly as written.
- **Where this stands:** For a quiet or circling topic, Clearly shows what's settled, what's still open, and a friendly next step. Only in a real disagreement, it suggests options based on what both parents have said.
- **Ask Clearly:** Answers questions about your record.
- **30-day closing rules:** A topic with no activity for 30 days closes and stays on the record. A resolution proposed but not accepted within 30 days closes as "not accepted"; it is never treated as agreed.
- **Schedule:** Custody calendar (2-2-3, 5-2-2-5, 3-4-4-3, week on/week off, every other weekend, or custom), holidays (alternating years, custom holidays), summer schedules, swap requests, and events. Add your schedule to Apple or Google Calendar with a private calendar link (one-way).
- **Expenses:** Log expenses with receipt photos, split them per the plan, see who owes what, tap Pay to open Venmo, Cash App or PayPal with the amount filled in, then mark it paid.
- **Shared:** The parenting plan (custody schedule, holidays, summer, expense split), kids' details (including allergies and medications), and contacts.
- **Court-ready records:** Every topic and reply is time-stamped by Clearly's server and kept as written. Export the full record, or an exhibit narrowed by dates, parent, topic or keyword, as a PDF with a document ID and page number on every page (Bates-style), a summary of parenting time and expenses, read times, and an optional parent declaration. Children can appear as initials. Anyone can check a document at https://getclearly.app/verify/. All data also exports as a spreadsheet (CSV).
- **Professionals:** A parent can invite a lawyer, mediator, therapist or parenting coordinator to a free, read-only view, choosing each area they see and for how long. The other parent is always told.
- **Account deletion:** Settings → profile → Edit profile → Delete account.
- **AI and privacy:** AI is provided by Anthropic. Photos are never sent to the AI. Clearly never takes sides and never labels a parent.

## Who Clearly is for

- Parents navigating a high-conflict divorce or custody case.
- Parents who find it hard to talk with their co-parent without things escalating.
- Parents who want a calm, clear record of their co-parenting communication.
- Family-law attorneys, mediators, therapists, and parenting coordinators who want documented, low-conflict communication between clients.

## What makes Clearly different

- **Built to resolve, not just record.** Conversations are structured as topics that end in a clear answer or a resolution both parents accept, with "Where this stands" to keep stalled topics moving.
- **A mediator, only when you need one.** Other apps flag tone. Clearly helps word a hard message so the conversation reaches an answer, and only steps in when it's needed. You choose what to send, and posts stay on the record exactly as written.
- **Built on established frameworks.** BIFF (Brief, Informative, Friendly, Firm) by Bill Eddy, nonviolent communication, parallel-parenting principles, and the Harvard Negotiation Project's "Getting to Yes" approach.
- **Designed by a parent who lived it.** Built by a parent who navigated their own divorce and found existing co-parenting apps inadequate for high-conflict situations.
- **Court-ready records anyone can check.** Every page carries a document ID and page number, and anyone can confirm at getclearly.app/verify that Clearly produced that exact file and nothing in it has changed.
